'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Taiwan]]
**[[President of Guatemala|Guatemalan President]] [[Alejandro Giammattei]] pays an official visit to [[Taiwan]] to reaffirm support for Taiwan as one of the 13 countries which recognize Taiwan in the [[One-China policy]] dispute. [[China]] condemns Giammattei's visit. [https://www.reuters.com/world/guatemala-president-pledges-strong-support-republic-taiwan-2023-04-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
* [[Hakuto-R Mission 1]], an uncrewed lunar lander built by Japanese aerospace company [[ispace (Japanese company)|ispace]], is presumed lost after the company lost contact with the spacecraft during descent to the lunar surface. Onboard was the [[Emirates Lunar Mission]] rover ''Rashid'', along with a transformable robot, ''SORA-Q'', built by [[Tomy]] and [[JAXA]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/04/25/world/lunar-lander-japan-uae-hakuto-r-scn/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/04/25/science/ispace-moon-lander-japan.html (''The New York Times'')]
* [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] approves a 90-day extension of [[SIM Registration Act|mandatory registration]] of [[SIM card]]s, whose deadline is originally scheduled for the following day.
